package.name: berxel_camera_driver
package.description: Camera driver node (camera_driver_node) for Berxel Hawk (iHawk) 3D depth cameras. Functionally identical to the Orbbec-based camera_driver package - publishes the fused /fusion/synced_robot_vision message with per-camera RGB image and depth point cloud (RGB colored, aligned to the color frame), /vision/rgb_raw, /SafeNode/Heartbeat and /SafeNode/status, provides /vision/Check_self and /vision/Reset action servers and the robot head-pose point cloud transform. The only difference from camera_driver is the low-level raw image data source (Berxel Hawk Linux SDK instead of the Orbbec SDK). The Berxel Hawk SDK (shared headers under SDK/Include/ plus native shared libraries split by architecture: SDK/x86 for x86_64 and SDK/arm for aarch64) is bundled under SDK/ so the package builds self-contained on both an x86_64 WSL host and an aarch64 RK3576 target (CMake picks the arch automatically).
